subject.title: Proposal: Publish a provider compatibility matrix with deprecation policy

question: Should OpenClaw commit to a public provider lifecycle matrix with stable/experimental/deprecated/broken statuses and deprecation windows across official, bundled, and community providers?
rationale: The proposal defines support guarantees, metadata ownership, and user-facing lifecycle promises, not just a missing docs table or CLI field.

options.title: Approve scoped lifecycle registry
options.body: Create a provider lifecycle registry with clear ownership, capability dimensions, deadlines, replacements, and issue links, then generate docs and doctor/models summaries from it.

options.title: Publish docs-only policy first
options.body: Start with a human-readable provider support and deprecation policy before adding a machine-readable registry or CLI output.

options.title: Defer broad guarantees
options.body: Keep provider status limited to live probe/catalog metadata and narrow follow-up work to specific provider regressions.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped lifecycle registry
recommendation.body: Create a provider lifecycle registry with clear ownership, capability dimensions, deadlines, replacements, and issue links, then generate docs and doctor/models summaries from it.
